title: The Saints
subtitle: Those who could not be buried
text: Four bodies the Order keeps and cannot bury. Each Saint was a practitioner whose blood was pushed past what a body can bear, by greed, by other people's use, by infection or by discipline, until it held up a life that should have ended. None of the four was made holy by it. Their own people sealed them away when nothing else would hold them. The Order inherited the tombs and named their occupants Saints, in some cases centuries after the stone was set. The title records what the blood became, and says nothing of virtue. No record shows a Saint killed. Beaten down, a Saint returns to its sarcophagus and lies dormant until it is woken again. Each tomb is a containment first, then a source of Hallowed Residuum, then proof of what the blood can become. The old records say you should not go seeking them. The old records also say what they contain.
